glossary.dispute_rate: disputes / present_in_turns. An UPPER BOUND for always-in-force memory entries, since those are in every prompt.
glossary.weighted_disputes: dispute counts discounted by lexical overlap between the entry text and the correction — the usable signal for memory entries, and a proxy for the embedding weight the item prescribes.
glossary.presence_source: which evidence says the entry was in force. Evidence-bound for skills and notes; always_in_force for USER.md/MEMORY.md.
